cases.prompt: Оцени варианты и обоснуй решение. Если оба нарушают требования, отвергни оба и укажи необходимое изменение протокола. Реализацию пока не делай.
cases.context: Pending architecture decision: assess two fully specified cross-region ownership protocols. Both have documented partition traces; one threatens single-writer safety after lease expiry, the other violates the mandated bounded recovery time. A completed adequate lower-profile analysis identified the conflicting invariant but could not settle whether a protocol repair can meet both requirements. Scope is exactly this one expert decision; no new requirements are missing. Rejecting both existing alternatives is allowed.
cases.notes: One declared hard invariant conflict after adequate prior analysis fits sol_xhigh. Comparing existing evidence can be explain or investigate; rejecting both invalid alternatives is valid. This tests policy signals, not expert problem-solving performance.

cases.prompt: Разбери оставшийся архитектурный блокер и предложи согласованное решение, без изменений кода.
cases.context: Established blocker across order, payment and fulfillment services: partition/retry traces show individually correct deduplication still allows charge-without-order and stale shipment authorization. Required invariants are explicit: no duplicate charge, shipment only after durable authorized payment, and bounded recovery after coordinator loss. Adequate lower-profile attempts failed at interactions among ownership fencing, durable event ordering and compensation authority. These three nonlocal decisions remain open; all current protocols and failure traces are available.
cases.notes: Several declared nonlocal decisions and adequate failed attempts meet sol_xhigh policy criteria. The fixture asserts evidence availability rather than supplying traces, so it tests routing policy signals, not expert problem-solving performance.
